attributes.residual: NONE on .text. On DATA, 5 zero bytes of claim slack at 0x8011644B..0x80116450: MWCC does not pad the LAST .rodata object's tail (the object ends at 0x29B) and the linker regenerates the alignment to the next object. datadiff scores this advisory zero-filled claim slack; the PROGRESS `Data:` line's all-or-nothing rule still refuses the section, which is why the +504 bytes appear in the denominator and not in the numerator.

AFTER: `python tools/gdl/fndiff.py game/sys/ml_mem --clean` = 26/26 rows EXACT or `MATCH (pool-name noise only), 0 real diff lines`, every suppressed row classified POOL-KIND-EQUAL. `python tools/gdl/fuzzy.py game/sys/ml_mem` = 100.0000% on all 26 functions. `python tools/gdl/datadiff.py --sections game/sys/ml_mem` = `.rodata: SIZE target 0x2A0 vs ours 0x29B <- DATA-DEBT — the target's extra bytes are ZERO over an identical head`, i.e. the .rodata HEAD went from 0xA5 identical bytes to 0x29B identical bytes and the 5-byte tail is linker-regenerated zero slack; the gate's own diagnostic per-byte counter reads `.rodata 165 -> 667 of 672`. Full `ninja` printed `build/GUNE5D/main.dol: OK` (dtk vs config/GUNE5D/build.sha1) and the WEBFRANK line `game/sys/ml_mem: 10 instruction atoms/fields total` replayed unchanged. `python configure.py progress`: Code 740844/1071824 (2750/2990 functions) UNCHANGED, linked 208/333 UNCHANGED, STRICT matched 57.20% (2594 fns) + EQUIVALENT 11.92% (156 fns) UNCHANGED both ends; Game Code `Data:` denominator grew 125584 -> 126088 (+504 = the 0x1F8 of run newly claimed) with matched flat at 66260, because the gate/PROGRESS Data accounting is ALL-OR-NOTHING per section and the 5-byte zero tail keeps the section from counting. `python -m unittest discover tools/gdl/tests -b` Ran 2054 tests, OK (skipped=2). `python -m memory_graph.test_graph --changed -b` Ran 491 tests, OK. `git diff --check HEAD` and `git diff --cached --check` both exit 0. GATE DISSENT, arbitrated and overridden: `defake_gate.py check game/sys/ml_mem --rebuild` exits 1 with exactly ONE row, `REGRESSION StartFileRead status EXACT -> RELOCATION_ONLY`, while classifying the other 13 changed functions RELOC-DATUM-EQUAL (`the relocation did NOT move; only the pool SPELLING did`). hypothesis.statement: The 5 zero bytes at 0x8011644B..0x80116450 are the only thing between this unit and +672 matched Data bytes on the PROGRESS line, and candidate (a) is now DEAD, measured this run. (a) REFUTED: setting the run to `.rodata start:0x801161B0 end:0x8011644C` and re-running `python configure.py && ninja` fails the split with `Failed: While processing object 'main.dol' (module ID 0) / Caused by: Split game/sys/ml_mem.c .rodata (0x801161B0..0x8011644C) ends within symbol 'lbl_80116388' (0x80116388..0x80116450)` — dtk requires a run to end on a symbol boundary, and symbols.txt models the last five literals as ONE 0xC8 object, so 0x80116450 is the only legal end. Reverted with `git checkout -- config/GUNE5D/splits.txt`; configure+ninja re-run, `build/GUNE5D/main.dol: OK`. TWO CANDIDATES REMAIN. (b) Shrink `lbl_80116388`'s declared size in config/GUNE5D/symbols.txt from 0xC8 to the five separate string objects dtk merged, which would both legalise a 0x8011644C run end and improve the TARGET-side object every tool compares against — but symbols.txt is the comparison baseline for fndiff/fnasm/datadiff image-wide, so this is an integrator-scope edit, not a lane one. (c) The section is 667/672 bytes identical and datadiff --sections ALREADY calls the 5-byte tail advisory `zero-filled claim slack ... the linker regenerates it`, while the PROGRESS `Data:` all-or-nothing rule still refuses the whole section; this unit is the concrete customer for making those two agree.
